abilities.critical_failure: As failure, but the target becomes a carrier for *The Enmity Cycle* for the next week. The target is compelled to travel to a city other than where they were exposed and recite as many lines from the anbarit as they can recall. Those who hear or witness the performance are treated as if they had attended a performance of *The Enmity Cycle*, but the Will save DC is 23.
abilities.critical_success: The target is unaffected and is immune to the effects for 1 day.
abilities.effect: All creatures other than Zridi in F2 take 2d8+9 mental damage (DC 25 basic Will save). The trap then rolls initiative.
abilities.failure: The target is frightened 2 for 1 minute and is certain the source of this fear is their fellow citizens, especially those from places other than their hometown. For 1 week the target suffers a –2 penalty to all Diplomacy skill checks against people from other Thuvian cities and regains the frightened 2 condition whenever they are in one of those cities.
abilities.name: Discordant Performance
abilities.success: The target is frightened 1 for 2 rounds.

traits.name: Emotion
traits.text: This effect alters a creature’s emotions. Effects with this trait always have the mental trait as well. Creatures with special training or that have mechanical or artificial intelligence are immune to emotion effects.

traits.name: Mental
traits.text: A mental effect can alter the target’s mind. It has no effect on an object or a mindless creature.

traits.name: Occult
traits.text:
This magic comes from the occult tradition, calling upon bizarre and ephemeral mysteries. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to occult magic.

abilities.trigger: Zridi spends an action to activate *The Enmity Cycle* while in area F2

hazard.description: Discordant music, dance, and poetry combine to build a deep suspicion and distrust of strangers.
hazard.disable: Performance DC 26 to counteract the performance or Religion or Occultism DC 27 to disrupt the spiritual energy. Three total successes are needed to disable the trap.
hazard.name: The Enmity Cycle
hazard.reset: A new production of *The Enmity Cycle* must be arranged; this process usually takes at least 1 week.
hazard.routine: (1 action) The performance continues to sow seeds of enmity, discord, and distrust on those in its area. All creatures in attendance other than Zridi must attempt a DC 25 Will save.

traits.name: Rare
traits.text: This rarity indicates that a rules element is very difficult to find in the game world. A rare feat, spell, item or the like is available to players only if the GM decides to include it in the game, typically through discovery during play. Creatures with this trait are rare. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creatures is increased by 5.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Curse
traits.text: A curse is an effect that places some long-term affliction on a creature. Curses are always magical and are typically the result of a spell or trap. Effects with this trait can be removed only by effects that specifically target curses.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
